paper_metadata.title: Achieving high strength and ductility in a dual-phase Mg-Li alloy via rotary swaging

evidence.quote: Achieving both high strength and ductility remains a challenge in dual-phase Mg-Li alloys. Although the high strength has been achieved through heat treatment or conventional deformation techniques, these methods result in low ductility. The Mg-8Li-3Zn-0.5Y alloy was processed using low-strain room-temperature rotary swaging (RS)
This work successfully designed and fabricated a novel Mg-8Li-3Zn-0.5Y alloy exhibiting a superior strength, employing room-temperature RS processing.
